environment.target: Node/Bun GitHub Actions, actual src/sockets.ts and WebSocket protocol via fake authorized harness; no real Cloudflare deploy

hypotheses.cause: Every significant tool/session event reads and serializes complete session history, then resends it to each socket
hypotheses.intervention: Per-socket prefix-checked incremental snapshot with explicit full fallback, no changes to model/Harness inference
hypotheses.prediction: At least 70% fewer outgoing WebSocket bytes for representative 160-message/25-event flow with identical transcript and busy/pending
hypotheses.falsification: Measured saving <70%, client desync, degraded rendering or excessive CPU

cases.expected: Exact final messages for baseline/delta; fallback full when not worthwhile
Identical final transcript, 70%+ fewer outgoing bytes
Updates to same message IDs, truncation/compaction and reconnect never leave stale messages

elapsed.provenance: OBSERVED wall-clock test runner; indicative only

thresholds.correctness: byte-for-byte equality of final message JSON and correct busy/pending
thresholds.shortNoRegression: no more bytes than full baseline

evidence_plan.journal: runs.jsonl emitted locally; CI logs with individual sample rows
evidence_plan.baseline: forced full mode of actual OpenCodeSessionSockets
evidence_plan.candidate: delta mode of exact same class
